name: Setif

queries.query: Setif Algeria official cadastral map parcel viewer cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Wilaya of Setif public qgis2web map, but the indexed description exposes wilaya/commune, roads, rail, industrial and tourism layers rather than cadastral parcels. It also identified ANFU, whose official mission page describes use of cadastre/conservation-fonciere data but does not publish a Setif parcel endpoint.

queries.query: سطيف الجزائر خريطة عقارية رسمية مسح الأراضي قطع الأراضي
queries.result: Arabic discovery found an official university catalogue entry for a study about land surveying in Sétif, not a public parcel service. French discovery found the same Wilaya viewer and the official national cartography viewer; neither exposed a bounded public parcel response.

registryBasis: No local cadastral registry, parcel map, or public parcel API was actually evidenced. General official cartography and agency descriptions are not treated as local parcel-service evidence.

officialSources.observation: Official Wilaya de Sétif qgis2web map is described as containing agglomerations, industrial/tourism zones, airports, Wilaya/commune boundaries, roads, railways, OSM and satellite imagery; no parcel layer was evidenced. Fetch attempt returned HTTP 502 from the research environment.
Official ASGA InfoGéolAlgérie 1:200,000 viewer exposes broad cartographic layers (Wilaya, communes, roads/topographic context), not a demonstrated parcel layer. Fetch attempt timed out.

Official ANFU page describes national urban-land missions and says its inventories use cadastre and land-conservation data; it does not provide a public Setif parcel geometry/ID service in the reviewed page.
University catalogue entry concerns a study evaluating land surveying in Wilaya de Sétif; it is research literature, not a parcel service.

remainingUncertainty: A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, or unusable viewer is not evidence of citywide parcel absence. The research did not establish the local cadastre/conservation-fonciere custodian's public API or a safe native parcel identity. No coordinate shift was made.
scopeLimits: Exact preserved WUP point [36.1929104072835, 5.41714395416834] was used in latitude/longitude order.
No parcel geometry, parcel ID, owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal field, credential, or private token was requested or retained.
No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification disable was used.
This packet records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
